name: Handbook
short: Short help cards and links to the online handbook; replaces [p]help.
description: Replaces Red's help with short cards: [p]help lists the handbook's topics with links, and [p]help <command> shows usage, who can use it, subcommands and links. [p]handbook links to topics, and the bot owner's [p]handbook export generates the command reference from the running bot as Markdown for the docs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Handbook! It replaces the help command, so unload any other help cog first (for example [p]unload customhelp), then reload this. Set the site with [p]handbook seturl <url>.
author: Quillshot
